purpose: Conformance corpus for it.neckar.financial.payment.card.ExpiryDate. Read by the Kotlin ExpiryDateTest and the Vitest of parseExpiryDate, formatExpiryDate and validateExpiryDateShape in @neckar-hub/typescript-utils/payment-formats. A case with `wire` pins the wire form. Every case is judged at `now`; a card is valid through the end of its expiry month. YearOutOfRange is the TypeScript check's own, because `formatExpiryDate` writes four-digit years; the Kotlin test skips those cases.
